title: Nexus: Integrations
summary: Use maps, records, missions, scans, and recovery plans to approach anomalies carefully.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: WorldCore can mark dangerous regions, TutorialCore can surface warnings, HoloMap marks return paths, and Armory or RelicTech may provide counters.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use WorldCore context, HoloMap return paths, Armory counters, RelicTech tools, and TutorialCore warnings to make each anomaly less blind.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: Without linked guidance, keep anomaly runs conservative: mark the boundary, note the trigger, bring a return kit, and leave before experimenting twice.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
